Source: Czech Statistical Office (ČSÚ), volby.gov.cz – open data on the 2022 and 2026 municipal elections (records of the polling-district commissions) and the 2022 and 2026 Senate elections; analysis by DataTimes.cz. Turnout = official envelopes issued / voters on the register, for the municipal council (Prague and statutory cities with city districts counted as a whole). 2022 covers only the regular elections of 23–24 September 2022; municipalities where no election was held in one of the years (no candidate list) or where it was held only as a repeat election are grey and excluded from the comparison. 2026 data: final results, ČSÚ export of 11 October 2026. Senate = a municipality where most voters also voted on the same day in the first round of the Senate elections.
